sources.alephChampLadder: competitor_teardown_pedagogy.md (research notes) citing Chabad SO 'Levels and Stripes' (https://www.chabadso.com/article.asp?aid=569858) and Chabad of Delta 'Champ at Home' (https://www.jewishdelta.com/templates/articlecco_cdo/aid/3737705/jewish/Champ-at-Home.htm)
sources.verifiedFromNotes: Aleph Champ ten levels: White = first 19 letters; last 13 letters at the red end (official site; which colour is which level is not stated there); Orange = first 3 vowels; Yellow = 6 vowels; Green = 9 vowels; Blue = all vowels + exceptions; Purple = basic prayers; Brown = higher-level tefillot; Grey = siddur reading within a time limit; top reading band is 50-53 words per minute on the official site; the 80+/100+ figures have no official support.
sources.caveat: The notes were secondary (the program sites were reached only through those pages). Aleph Champ is a children's classroom programme and its order is letters-before-vowels; Aleph interleaves letters and vowels in primer order, so Aleph belts reuse the names and top-of-ladder wpm but the gates below are Aleph's own adaptation.

belts.name: White
belts.gate: Reads Shabbat Shalom; Shin Bet Tav Lamed final-Mem Vav, kamatz/patach/cholam/dagesh.

belts.name: Red
belts.gate: About 19 letters incl. finals, 7 vowel signs, first decoded Priestly-Blessing line.

belts.name: Orange
belts.gate: All 27 letter shapes recognised; chataf vowels; Shema line 1 decoded.

belts.name: Green
belts.gate: Blessing formula fluent; shva, dagesh and stress rules applied.

belts.name: Blue
belts.gate: All 15 signs plus exceptions (kamatz katan, prefixes, the Name).

belts.name: Purple
belts.gate: Basic prayers: Shema, V'ahavta, Torah blessings, Modeh Ani, Mah Tovu, Kiddush.

belts.name: Brown
belts.gate: Higher prayers: Avot, Mi Chamocha, Aleinu, Kaddish, Adon Olam, Birkat Hamazon opener.

belts.name: Grey
belts.gate: Siddur page read inside a time limit.
belts.wpmStatus: Aleph Champ states a time limit without a published number in our notes; 70 is Aleph's proposal

belts.name: Black
belts.gate: Fluency target after the lesson graph ends; practice with timed reads.
belts.wpmStatus: UNVERIFIED: official Aleph Champ top band is 50-53 wpm; 80 is Aleph's own proposal, not sourced

measurement: Words per minute on POINTED siddur text read aloud, errors subtracted (counted words read correctly / minutes). Not yet automated: needs ASR from another lane or self-report.
